notes.text: Tiberius Julius Caesar Augustus was the second Roman emperor from AD 14 until his death, reigning as the second ruler of the Julio-Claudian dynasty.
Tiberius succeeded his stepfather Augustus, the first Roman emperor.
Tiberius was born in Rome in 42 BC to politician Tiberius Claudius Nero and his wife, Livia Drusilla.
Following the untimely deaths of Augustus's two grandsons and adopted heirs, Gaius and Lucius Caesar, Tiberius was designated Augustus's successor.
Prior to this, Tiberius had proved himself an able diplomat and one of the most successful Roman generals.
